html.inner_html:
Q3 Roadmap

  • Cut onboarding time in half
  • Ship the public API
  • Move billing off the legacy provider

Engineering headcount stays flat at twelve.

text.text: The Q3 roadmap focuses on three key themes: (1) halving onboarding time, (2) launching the public API, and (3) migrating billing away from the legacy provider — all while keeping the engineering team steady at 12 people.

images.caption: A visual roadmap illustration showing three parallel tracks labeled 'Onboarding', 'Public API', and 'Billing Migration', arranged as a timeline across Q3, with a small team-of-twelve icon anchored at the side to represent stable headcount.
